title: GLG Enhances AI-Moderated Calls: Autonomous Expert Interviews in 10 Languages
summary: GLG released an enhanced AI-Moderated Calls offering in which an AI Moderator conducts structured expert interviews autonomously in 10 languages: English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, German, Russian, Japanese, Korean, and Mandarin. The moderator follows client discussion guides, probes with follow-up questions, and can collect multiple-choice, scale, and matrix responses exportable to Excel. Calls need no calendar coordination and can run simultaneously across time zones; transcripts can be synthesized in one click with outputs traceable to named experts and timestamps. GLG says clients report cutting time-to-insight to hours.
whyItMatters: AI-moderated interviewing is now offered by GLG, Guidepoint, AlphaSense/Tegus, NewtonX, and proSapient — shifting part of the expert-call market from scheduled one-to-one conversations to asynchronous, parallel interviews at scale.
